samples.question: This image has two framed panels. The upper panel is a board: it shows four dark square outlines, exactly one of which is filled light gray, and one solid black cross. The lower panel is a clear sheet: it shows four solid colored dots (one red, one blue, one green, one orange) and one solid black cross of the same size and shape. The sheet is slid straight onto the board - without rotating it, mirroring it or changing its size - until the sheet's black cross lies exactly on top of the board's black cross. Every dot moves by that same shift and by nothing else. After that shift, which colored dot is closest to the center of the light gray square? Answer with one word: red, blue, green, or orange.
